verdict.meaning: the run's verdict, which G6 decides outside the run from its exit code and counts (repo_tests._judge)

said.meaning: G6's own words for the run's verdict, in a check's detail

output.meaning: pytest's printed lines: a test id it found none of, and a file it could not collect

rootdir.meaning: the folder pytest named every id relative to (_in_repository); one that is not text makes all unknown
rootdir.constraint: repository-relative text; exactly empty when pytest never supplied a root

test_outcomes.constraint: complete ordered phases; null only for a non-ran diagnostic without phase data

failed_ids.meaning: the tests the runner lists as failed: each is a test of the run (phases_of); replay diagnostics preserve its raw identity scope, emission order and first five entries; setup errors are separate

setup_errors.meaning: the tests whose set-up failed on a fixture pytest could not find: each is a test of the run

collected_ids.meaning: the tests collected: one of a check that started that reported no phase and was not left out never finished (_verdicts)

omitted_ids.meaning: the tests collected and left out of the session (deselected): never a pass (_verdicts)

passed.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
passed.constraint: machine count; phase and annotation bounds, aggregate total, omitted count

failed.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
failed.constraint: machine count; phase and annotation bounds, aggregate total, omitted count

not_passed.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
not_passed.constraint: machine count; phase and annotation bounds, aggregate total, omitted count

total.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
total.constraint: machine count; phase and annotation bounds, aggregate total, omitted count

deselected.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
deselected.constraint: machine count; phase and annotation bounds, aggregate total, omitted count

collected.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
consumers: producer progress/schema; not forwarded as a downstream decision
collected.constraint: equals the corresponding identity or phase count

started.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
consumers: producer progress/schema; not forwarded as a downstream decision
started.constraint: equals the corresponding identity or phase count

finished.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test
consumers: producer progress/schema; not forwarded as a downstream decision
finished.constraint: equals the corresponding identity or phase count

degraded.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test (a summary of the counts)

completed.meaning: a count: the run's verdict (repo_tests._judge) reads it; a count names no test (a summary of the counts)

own_config.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did

loaded_complete.meaning: what the run's copy left out or the run loaded from elsewhere: _loaded_elsewhere and _record read it

seconds.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did

python.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did

interpreter_source.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did

command.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did

source_before.meaning: the snapshot the run began on: _run_again reads it, to refuse a run of another tree

receipt.meaning: the run's test receipt, or why it has none: the coding gate reads it

receipt_withheld.meaning: the run's test receipt, or why it has none: the coding gate reads it

receipt_error.meaning: the run's test receipt, or why it has none: the coding gate reads it

baseline.meaning: a replay's verdict at the base commit (run_before): _on_base reads it; it names no test

patched.meaning: a replay's verdict on the patch when it did not match its tests (run_before): _on_base reads it

changed.meaning: the tracked files the run changed: its verdict says so (changed_tracked_files, never believed)
changed.constraint: text members; os_errors annotate recorded failures

os_errors.meaning: why a failure happened, by the failure's id: a test's is also in failed_ids or setup_errors (the plugin lists every failed report in one of the two), and a file's is one pytest could not collect, which the output names; read as a test it would turn a file that could not collect into a failed test
os_errors.constraint: text members; os_errors annotate recorded failures

import_path.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did
import_path.constraint: text members; os_errors annotate recorded failures

env_set_by_g6.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did
env_set_by_g6.constraint: text members; os_errors annotate recorded failures

ignored_loadable.meaning: the run's test receipt, or why it has none: the coding gate reads it
consumers: producer progress/schema; not forwarded as a downstream decision
ignored_loadable.constraint: text members; os_errors annotate recorded failures

failure_messages.meaning: why a failure happened, by the failure's id: a test's is also in failed_ids or setup_errors (the plugin lists every failed report in one of the two), and a file's is one pytest could not collect, which the output names; read as a test it would turn a file that could not collect into a failed test
failure_messages.constraint: failed phase, or an uncollected collection failure; never omitted

consumers: producer progress/schema; not forwarded as a downstream decision
messages.constraint: failed phase, or an uncollected collection failure; never omitted

repo_env.meaning: how the run was made, never what a test did

loaded_outside.meaning: what the run's copy left out or the run loaded from elsewhere: _loaded_elsewhere and _record read it

submodules_not_hashed.meaning: what the run's copy left out or the run loaded from elsewhere: _loaded_elsewhere and _record read it

links_left_out.meaning: what the run's copy left out or the run loaded from elsewhere: _loaded_elsewhere and _record read it

links_materialised.meaning: what the run's copy left out or the run loaded from elsewhere: _loaded_elsewhere and _record read it

generated_copied.meaning: what the run's copy left out or the run loaded from elsewhere: _loaded_elsewhere and _record read it

generated_left_out.meaning: what the run's copy left out or the run loaded from elsewhere: _loaded_elsewhere and _record read it

ignored_inputs.meaning: the run's test receipt, or why it has none: the coding gate reads it
consumers: producer progress/schema; not forwarded as a downstream decision

isolation.meaning: the boundary the run had: _confined refuses a run none confined, before it is read

test_outcomes.partial: unknown body; preserves started identity and diagnostic verdict

values.loaded_outside: absent: recorded control; empty mapping: no outside module; named module: match source tails
values.loaded_complete: absent with no listing: recorded control; False with listing: unknown loading; True: complete listing
values.rootdir: empty: top/no pytest root; relative prefix: test identity; partial record keys retain started vs never reached
values.isolation.backend: absent: recorded control; null/empty: refusal; nonempty: boundary recorded
values.isolation.network: False: isolated offline; True: network allowed
values.baseline/patched: absent vs not_run vs passed vs failed/collection_error: refusal vs ran-but-unkept replay
values.degraded/completed: exact booleans; incomplete run cannot supply a stored passing receipt
values.counts: zero/positive; passes plus failures is total, skips excluded; JUnit groups may merge identities
values.output/failure_messages/os_errors: missing id and collection error text; assertion vs access-error diagnostics; observation output
values.source_before/receipt: absent vs present; exact snapshot digest and stored receipt identity
values.copy_annotations: absent/empty vs entries: forward observed omissions/hashes and withheld receipt reason
values.ordered_raw_failed_ids: replay detail reads only failed_ids, in emission order and without rootdir qualification; phase evidence uses qualified identities and the failure union
